chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar from Musa ibn 'Umar from Ibn Abi 'Umayr from some of our companions from Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him)
Regarding a man who married a woman on condition of a house, he said: 'She has a house, the middle one.'

key_terms.مَهْر: Dowry or bridal gift given by the husband to the wife

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a man marries a woman with a house as dowry but does not specify which house?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Rida (AS) clarifies the principle of *al-sawt* (average/medium standard) when a dowry is specified as a 'house' without further qualification. This ruling ensures fairness by preventing disputes over specific property values, reflecting the Shia juristic emphasis on equitable compensation (*mahr al-mithl*) in marital contracts.
